title: Berkeley admissions paradox, simple model
content: Figure 9.4 separates the mediated Gender -> Department -> Outcome path from the direct Gender -> Outcome path. For the discrimination question, fixing Department disables the indirect path so the direct effect remains.

variables.name: Gender
variables.content: The applicant attribute whose direct effect is the discrimination question.

variables.name: Department
variables.content: The applicant's department choice and mediator.

arrows.because: Figure 9.4 includes gender-related differences in department choice.
Figure 9.4 includes the direct path representing discrimination.
